run_calculate_runner: run a CalculateRunner to execute an ASE calculator and write results to a results directory
implement_calculate_method: implement the abstract calculate method in a subclass of CalculateRunner to perform custom calculations
implement_write_results_method: implement the abstract write_results method in a CalculateRunner subclass to save results to a directory
load_state_from_checkpoint: load a previously saved CalculateRunner state from a checkpoint directory to resume interrupted calculations
create_calculate_runner_subclass: create a subclass of CalculateRunner that accepts an ASE calculator and input data sequence
